title: fix: clean comments in text in getDiagramFromText API so flowchart works well
body:
Resolves #5075 

## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

This bug was introduced in v10.5.0 in https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/pull/4759 and since the comments are not being cleaned when using the `getDiagramFromText` API, hence the flowchart with comments breaks.

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

I am calling the API `cleanupComments` in Diagram constructor to make sure the comments are always removed before creation and this works fine.
